authority.note: Packet/source forensics only; no runtime, canonical-semantics, HCU or training promotion.

architecture_findings.finding: gespraech_erinnerung stores subject/value/quelle without explicit epistemic or transformation class, immutable source-event identity, admission identity, privacy tier or evidence provenance sufficient to distinguish verbatim claims from summaries/inferences.

The direct Realtime read path returns conversation-memory and durable-memory rows in one result collection with source labels but no explicit fact/claim/summary/inference typing; the wrapper does not insert deterministic epistemic admission.

The inspected direct Realtime path does not support the counterhypothesis that downstream retrieval already preserves an explicit claim-versus-fact distinction. This result is bounded to the inspected direct Realtime consumer and must not be generalized to all repository retrieval paths without audit.

frankenstein_2_successor_contract.MemoryAdmission_law: Model/function-call output proposes a MemoryCandidate. A deterministic admission step decides whether and how it is persisted. Remembering that an actor said X never promotes X itself to factual truth.
frankenstein_2_successor_contract.retrieval_law: Every returned item preserves source, transformation, epistemic class and provenance; ranking or context compilation must not erase those classes.
frankenstein_2_successor_contract.canonical_fact_law: Promotion to canonical factual evidence requires separately admissible evidence; memory is not observation authority.

triggerword4_acceptance_tests: VERBATIM user utterance and model SUMMARY remain structurally distinguishable after persistence and retrieval.
A model INFERENCE remains INFERRED/MODEL_CANDIDATE and cannot satisfy an OBSERVED/FACT evidence query.
Mixed conversation-memory and durable-memory retrieval returns explicit provenance/epistemic metadata on every item and ranking preserves it.
Sensitive spoken content rejected or redacted by policy leaves an auditable admission result without persisting disallowed raw content.
preserved_unknowns: Other non-Realtime retrieval consumers may add stronger epistemic typing and require separate audit.
No runtime evidence here establishes the proposed successor contract is implemented or enforced.
next_exact_gate: Audit all other gespraech_erinnerung/durable_memory consumers for epistemic typing, then feed the bounded MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission contract into Triggerword-4 assembly with fail-closed provenance-preservation tests.
